abilities.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to launch 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

abilities.name: Starfell Sword
_curatorNotes: Skill cast (Tap E): hitmark=62f, 248% ATK Geo at lvl=10 (skill multiplier). Drops a Meteorite construct that lasts 30s (40s with C6). 3-4 Geo particles per cast (33% chance for 4).
Cooldown: SetCDWithDelay(skill, c.skillCD=6s, skillCDStart[0]=23). A1 reduces by 2s → 4s base CD when ascended (ascension≥1). Authored via cooldownModifiers.
Short-Hold variant: hitmark=29f (faster cast), same scaling, separate frame profile (skillFrames[1][0]=InitAbilSlice(54)). Authored as variant with shorter frames; same cooldown/scaling.

Meteorite construct: counts as a Geo construct (Crystallize-able). C2 'Rockcore Meltdown' makes the meteorite explode for 248% ATK Geo when destructed — not authored as separate effect (would need a destruct trigger primitive).
Frames: skillFrames[0][0]=InitAbilSlice(81), ActionDash=25 ActionJump=24 ActionSwap=67. Per E-spec swap/N/Q/D/J — Q defaults to animLen=81.
abilities.description:
Calls upon the power of Geo to summon forth a giant Meteorite that will deal AoE Geo DMG to opponents in front of you upon impact.

The Meteorite remains on the field after impact and acts as Geo-imbued matter. It can also be destroyed by enemy attacks.

abilities.name: Wake of Earth
_curatorNotes: Burst hits: 4 shockwaves at burstHitmark=51 + 15*(i+1) (i=0..3) — so 66, 81, 96, 111f from cast. Per-tick 148% ATK Geo at lvl=10.

Spawns 4 walls (Geo construct shields) at +-2.75/+-6.67 offsets, 15s duration (20s with C6). Authored as a single summon entry 'Wake of Earth Wall' representing the wall set. Walls are stationary and don't follow the active char.
Burst frames: burstFrames[0]=InitAbilSlice(67), ActionDash/Jump=42 ActionSwap=51. Per Q-spec swap/N/E/D/J — N/E default to animLen=67.
Cooldown: SetCDWithDelay(burst, 900f, burstStart=35). EnergyMax=60. ConsumeEnergy(37) drains 37 energy from teammates.
C1 Aftershock: party members within radius +10% CR + interrupt RES. Schema-fit: would need a 'duringSummon' state condition on a team buff; possible but not authored — flagged.
C4 Shoreline: -5 Energy per enemy hit (max 25 from one cast). Authored conceptually but per-hit-energy-callback not modeled.
abilities.description: Energy from deep underground bursts forth, dealing AoE Geo DMG and forming a Stone Stele that deals continuous AoE Geo DMG to opponents within its AoE.

passives.name: Frenzied Rockslide
_curatorNotes: A1: Starfell Sword CD reduced by 2s. Authored on the skill via cooldownModifiers.

passives.name: Resonant Waves
_curatorNotes: A4: Wake of Earth shockwaves count as elemental crystals to form Crystallize shields if there are no Geo constructs nearby. Not modeled (Crystallize shielding mechanic is out of planner scope).
passives.description: Wake of Earth's shockwaves count as elemental crystals to form Crystallize shields if there are no Geo constructs nearby.

constellations.name: Aftershock
_curatorNotes: C1: party members within Wake of Earth radius gain +10% CR + interrupt RES. Schema-fit: team buff with state:duringSummon condition gated on Wake of Earth wall summon. Not authored — duringSummon state isn't reliably entered for stationary-construct summons in the parser.
constellations.description: Party members within the radius of Wake of Earth have their CRIT Rate increased by 10% and have increased resistance against interruption.

constellations.name: Rockcore Meltdown
_curatorNotes: C2: when Starfell Sword Meteorite is destroyed (manually or by duration end), it explodes for an additional skill[lvl] = 248% ATK Geo at lvl=10. Construct-destruct trigger primitive missing; not authored.
constellations.description: When destroyed, Starfell Sword's Meteorite will deal 200% ATK as Geo DMG to nearby opponents.

constellations.name: Will of the Rock
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Wake of Earth by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Shoreline
_curatorNotes: C4: Wake of Earth regenerates +5 Energy per opponent hit, max 25 per cast. Per-hit energy-callback gating + max-cap state not authorable cleanly. Not authored.
constellations.description: The shockwave triggered by Wake of Earth regenerates 5 Energy for every opponent hit. A maximum of 25 Energy can be regenerated in this manner at any one time.

constellations.name: Rite of Dispatch
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Starfell Sword by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Broken Rock, Severed Waves
_curatorNotes: C6: Wake of Earth wall +5s (15→20s); Starfell Sword Meteorite +10s (30→40s). Authored conceptually via durationModifiers but the schema doesn't currently support summon-duration-modifier-via-constellation; flagged.
constellations.description:
The barrier created by Wake of Earth lasts 5s longer.
The meteorite created by Starfell Sword lasts 10s longer.
